import unittest
from copy import deepcopy
from solution import dispatch_zone_jobs


class DispatchZoneJobsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_matching_order_duplicates_and_return(self):
        entries = [
            {'identifier': 'a', 'location': {'zone': 'east'}},
            {'identifier': 'b', 'location': {'zone': 'west'}},
            {'identifier': 'a', 'location': {'zone': 'east'}},
        ]
        seen = []
        self.assertIs(dispatch_zone_jobs(entries, 'east', seen.append), True)
        self.assertEqual(seen, ['a', 'a'])

    def test_no_matches_and_empty_list(self):
        self.assertIs(dispatch_zone_jobs([], 'east', lambda value: None), True)
        seen = []
        entries = [{'identifier': 3, 'location': {'zone': 'west'}}]
        self.assertIs(dispatch_zone_jobs(entries, 'east', seen.append), True)
        self.assertEqual(seen, [])

    def test_does_not_mutate_nested_input(self):
        entries = [{'identifier': ['mutable'], 'location': {'zone': 'z', 'extra': []}}]
        before = deepcopy(entries)
        dispatch_zone_jobs(entries, 'z', lambda value: None)
        self.assertEqual(entries, before)

    def test_invalid_outer_arguments(self):
        for bad in (None, (), {}, 'entries'):
            with self.subTest(bad=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    dispatch_zone_jobs(bad, 'z', lambda value: None)
        for bad in (None, 1, ''):
            with self.subTest(zone=bad):
                expected = ValueError if bad == '' else TypeError
                with self.assertRaises(expected):
                    dispatch_zone_jobs([], bad, lambda value: None)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            dispatch_zone_jobs([], 'z', 42)

    def test_malformed_entries_are_rejected(self):
        malformed = [
            [1],
            [{}],
            [{'identifier': 1}],
            [{'identifier': 1, 'location': 'z'}],
            [{'identifier': 1, 'location': {}}],
        ]
        for entries in malformed:
            with self.subTest(entries=entries):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    dispatch_zone_jobs(entries, 'z', lambda value: None)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
